# Gengchou v2.5.3

## Changes

- Say when an update is available. The daily check already found new versions
  on its own, but a check that nobody asked for raised nothing: the only trace
  was the version entry inside the **Settings** submenu, which is not somewhere
  anyone opens unprompted, so a release could sit unnoticed for as long as the
  user never went looking. Gengchou now raises a silent balloon from its own
  tray icon naming the version and where to take it. It is announced once per
  version - the check repeats every 24 hours and repeating the announcement
  with it would be nagging - and the menu entry still carries the offer until
  the update is taken. A check the user starts from the menu is unchanged: it
  answers in the dialog it always did, not in a balloon.
